subject: general
question: In a certain code, the word COMPAQ is written as DQNRBS and SONY is written as TQOA. In the same code, how is MOTOROLA written?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Alternately (1) and (2) are added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​​So,

 
• COMPAQ is written as DQNRBS

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22fbae2ef96d43d8252064bf5e810a14f33266028381dffdea3afadf24d3c40c.png] 

​And,

 
• SONY is written as TQOA

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13d3840972782eaf40b1291f492fa81d9d3a6df18ab86e67c061c3e53fd4e7ca.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• MOTOROLA is written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1be789e6c17fa25671868fed4ead228051a1cb8cb9b734e3a3b21007f8d52e9.png] 

Hence, **"NQUQSQMC**" is the correct answer.
